gloss: 'In the Shith of the Sanctuary ([or] settlement), in the North, in the hole...'; revised MS: 'In the pit ([or] foundation) nearby'
argument: שכינה 'divine presence', i.e. the sanctuary; the yod 'a small stroke at the top of the nun'

gloss: 'In the pit nearby, towards the north in a hole opening toward the north near the graves'
source: Lefkovits 2000 pp. 425-426 and n. 2; Wolters, CSS p. 320 n. 27

gloss: 'In the Pit (Shîth) adjoining on the north, in a hole opening northwards'
'At the tunnel in the Smooth Rock to the north of Kohlit, which opens towards the north'
'Dans la galerie du Rocher Lisse au nord de Koḥlit, qui s'ouvre vers le nord'
argument: צחיח סלע (Ezek 24:7; 26:4, 14), shining smooth rock, 'si la lecture est bonne'; reading note: 'צח, malgré la tête très petite du ṣadé, semble préférable à ינח où les deux premières lettres seraient en ligature, comparable à celle de la l. 9'

gloss: 'In the nearby pit (or cave) in the north of Koḥalit'
'In the underground passage that is in Ṣehab north of Koḥlit'
argument: Ṣehab = Tell Shihab near the Yarmuk

gloss: 'In the cavity, which is in Janoaḥ ... in the north there is a kaḥolet (black object)'
argument: Ynḥ 10 km SE of Gerizim = ינוח of Josh 16:6-7

gloss: 'In the deep pit which is in Janoah, in the north of Kaḥelet, its entrance is hidden'
argument: the symbol after bet is 'either a ligature of yod plus nun or a ṣade, followed by a he/ḥet/taw'; Janoah of Josh 16:6-7 is listed with Upper Beth-horon and Jericho; Ephraim (Kh. Yanun) rather than Galilee; alternatives listed: Jonah/dove, Noah, marsh (ṣade), Ṣehab, Ṣiaḥ, Ṣaḥ, dry land, Shebna
Lefkovits p. 426: García Martínez 'agrees with Pixner'; Puech 2006 n. 506 lists García Martínez & Tigchelaar with the šbynḥ readers

gloss: 'In the dry well that is at the north of Kohlit'

reading: {שבצח} deleted as partial dittography of שבצפון
שכנה ('so my edition') = Shekinah; or nun preceded by waw/yod
gloss: 'In the cavern of the Presence on the north of Koḥlit'
argument: examined the original in Amman in 1991: no horizontal cross-stroke; the short vertical 'may be an accidental scratch or discoloration'; 'certainly not a ṣade'; 'either a nun alone ... or a nun preceded by a waw or yod'
'neither ṣade nor yod can be inserted'
source: Puech, CSS p. 78; Puech 2006 p. 206 n. 507

gloss: 'Dans la fosse qui se trouve au nord de Koḥlit, son ouverture est cachée avec des tombeaux à son entrée'
argument: the right-hand stroke touches the next and is a double strike of the burin; 'De yod inséré il n'y a point, encore moins de ṣade'; šknh = qal fem. perfect of kwn 'qui se trouve' (rare in Hebrew, attested in Phoenician-Punic), or haplography for š(b)knh 'at the base' (cf. VI 7), or šbnh 'which was built'/'of Shebna'

gloss: 'the pit at Janoaḥ north of Kaḥelet'
argument: 'obligatory when one examines carefully the copies of Wright-Baker and Milik; Allegro's copy is slightly different here, and does not allow the reading Janoaḥ'
